title: GDS Agent for Graph Algorithmic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2508.20637v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable multimodal information processing and reasoning ability. When equipped with tools through function calling and enhanced with retrieval-augmented techniques, compound LLM-based systems can access closed data sources and answer questions about them. However, they still struggle to process and reason over large-scale graph-structure data. In this technical report we introduce the GDS (Graph Data Science) agent. The GDS agent introduces a comprehensive set of graph algorithms as tools, together with preprocessing (retrieval) and postprocessing of algorithm results, in a model context protocol (MCP) server. translated_title: 面向图算法推理的 GDS 智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经展现出卓越的多模态信息处理与推理能力。当通过函数调用为其配备工具，并结合检索增强技术后，基于LLM的复合系统可以访问封闭的数据源并回答与之相关的问题。然而，它们在处理和推理大规模图结构数据方面仍然存在困难。在本技术报告中，我们介绍了 GDS（图数据科学）智能体。GDS 智能体在模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器中引入了一套全面的图算法作为工具，并配套了算法结果的预处理（检索）与后处理功能。同时，它还附带一项技能（skill），用于引导 LLM 完成图分析任务。该智能体可与任何现代 LLM 开箱即用。GDS 智能体允许用户提出任何隐含或本质上需要对数据进行图算法推理的问题，并快速获得答案。
tldr: GDS 智能体通过 MCP 服务器将一整套图算法封装为工具并提供预处理与后处理流程，使任何现代 LLM 都能开箱即用地对大规模图结构数据进行算法推理。
en_tdlr: The GDS agent packages a comprehensive suite of graph algorithms as tools within an MCP server, enabling any modern LLM to perform out-of-the-box algorithmic reasoning over large-scale graph-structured data.
